query:
SELECT id, name, latin_name, category, conservation_status, cites_appendix, olfactive_signature,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.plant_id = p.id) as molecule_count
FROM plants p
WHERE conservation_status IS NOT NULL AND conservation_status != 'NE' AND conservation_status != 'LC'
ORDER BY 
  CASE conservation_status 
    WHEN 'EX' THEN 1 WHEN 'EW' THEN 2 WHEN 'CR' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'EN' THEN 4 WHEN 'VU' THEN 5 WHEN 'NT' THEN 6 
    ELSE 7 END,
  name;
